November 5, 2020
IIT Madras BS in Data Science and Applications Channel
Dear learner:


We have so far completed 3 graded assignments and awaiting the list of
candidates eligible to appear for the qualifier exam. The list will be
announced soon.

To answer the question on syllabus for mock test: ALL 4 WEEKS of content in
ALL 4 SUBJECTS are required to be studied and questions will come from this
content.

Since the graded assignments had 10 days or more time to solve and week 4
did not have a graded assignment, based on requests from learners we have
decided to conduct 2 timed mock tests as given below of 90 minutes each.


*Test Date*

*Test Time (IST)*

*Test Subjects*

11th November, 2020

7.30 PM – 9 PM

Mathematics for Data Science I

English I

12th November, 2020

7.30 PM – 9 PM

Statistics for Data Science I

Computational Thinking



· This is a mock test for students to practice giving the examination
in a timed format. The number of questions, marks etc may vary from the
Qualifier Examination.

· The test will be available in the form of an Assignment each inside
English and Maths-1 course on 11th November, 2020 and as an Assignment
each again inside Statistics-1 and CT courses on 12th November, 2020.

· The link will open and assignment will become available at 7:30pm
IST sharp on both days and accept submissions till 9pm IST. At 9pm IST, the
assignment due date will be over and submissions will close. Answers and
scores will be visible after that.

· For those who miss the above, these will be available with
Checkanswers button enabled thereafter if hey want to practice.

· These are purely for practice and will not be counted anywhere.

So good luck and prepare well for the mock tests!
Thanks,
IITM online degree team.

--

Dear candidate,

Greetings from IIT Madras.

Hall ticket is ready and is up for dispatch. At this stage we normally would not accommodate city/centre changes.

But considering the pandemic situation and inability to travel, we are giving you the last chance to change the exam city.

The exam centre allocated within the city chosen will be as per availability of nodes.

Please note that we cannot accept / entertain requests to change exam centres within cities or exam time slots / shifts.

Kindly use the google form attached to change the exam city.

Form Link : bit.ly/POD_CC

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
NOTE: Google form will be closed by 12th NOV 2020 12:00 NOON, no more changes will be entertained after deadline.
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Regards,
IIT Madras Online Degree Team
